I replied to Hollis in the DM: I noted that his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Brindle rollout is now Tuesdays at 15:30. I also told him I didn't change anything on his calendar.

I didn't save it to the brain separately. The workspace already records every DM between me and a member as a fact visible only to that member, so this will come up when Hollis asks. A separate save could have made it visible more widely. It stays private to him under the DM rule.
